explanation: The first preorder entry is the root. Scan for the first entry belonging to the right subtree, then recursively build the left and right ranges. Repeated partition scans make skewed inputs quadratic.
timeComplexity: O(n²) worst case; O(n log n) for balanced partitions
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion stack plus O(n) returned nodes
